title.zh: 废止第2959号共和国法（即《授予Pedro Bangug在伊莎贝拉省Cabagan市镇经营电灯、热力与电力系统特许权》）的法案
title.en: An Act Repealing Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Fifty-Nine, Entitled "An Act Granting Pedro Bangug a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela"
title.orig: An Act Repealing Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Fifty-Nine, Entitled "An Act Granting Pedro Bangug a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela"

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5219_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Republic Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and fifty-nine, entitled "An Act granting Pedro Bangug a franchise for an electric light, heat and power system in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela," is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
